contactSub: Open to full-stack, DevOps and cloud engineering roles. Happy to talk about building a product, shipping it, or keeping it running.
bio: I'm a full-stack developer and DevOps engineer at Amalitech in Ghana. I build web apps end to end with React, Angular, Node.js and Python, then run them on AWS with Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines that test and scan every change before it ships. I studied Computer Science at KNUST and trained as a full-stack engineer through ALX, so I'm as at home reviewing a pull request as I am debugging a failed deploy.
name: Benjamin Yankey
tagline: Building the product and the platform it runs on.
